audit.episode_audit_note: Repeated states/questions are not independent episodes. Single-outcome cells are retained without forced balancing. Missing episode IDs are counted explicitly and excluded from episode totals.

maze_feasibility.purpose: Evaluation feasibility audit only; oracle geometry and paths never enter model observations or training labels.
maze_feasibility.method: Independent breadth-first search on the simulator full wall graph from reset position to goal; compare minimum physical moves with the fixed physical-attempt deadline.
maze_feasibility.interpretation: Shortest distance is a lower bound: collisions and code repositioning also consume attempts. Distance <= deadline means an ideal full-information path exists, not that a partially observed policy will discover it. Distance > deadline makes success impossible for every policy under this frozen deadline.

metric_definitions.game_success: completed successful episodes / all cases in the declared split and task
metric_definitions.task_macro: unweighted mean of the three task success rates
metric_definitions.vector_brier: sum of squared probability errors over false and true (twice scalar Bernoulli Brier)
metric_definitions.outcome_evaluation: executed actions under the frozen SFT sample continuation policy; independent of fresh Q-controller completion
